label: Thai Paradise EDH (Thai)
note: Four clean single-column portrait pages with numbered items — the easiest layout in the corpus, kept as a control: if extraction fails here, it is not a layout problem. Most mains have no price on their own line because price depends on the protein ('CHOICES OF MEAT…' boxes, not dishes). Photo captions under the photo strips repeat dish names with their numbers ('1. Fresh Spring Rolls', '4. Sa-Tay', '15. Pad Thai', '23. Green Curry'…). Sides, desserts and drinks on p4 have their prices in a separate column at the bottom of the text layer, but sit beside their items on the page. The name 'Thai Paradise EDH' is the page title on p1.
